xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an order from the Joint Commissioner of Customs Adjudication (I), ACC, Mumbai Zone-III under Section 28(4) of the Customs Act, 1962, raising a demand of ₹4,50,835/- for short-paid duty due to an incorrect exemption claim under Notification No. 46/2011-Customs, along with applicable interest.
